title: Unimodular dark energy from an Ohmic bath

baseline.label: LambdaCDM
baseline.scope: Coordinator-declared comparison convention; not an assertion that the source retains the full LambdaCDM sectors or adopts a source posterior.
baseline.parameters_reason: No numerical reference inputs adopted for this source-development prospect.

cosmology.gravity: Dissipative unimodular gravity in the source symmetry-reduced Hamiltonian setting.
cosmology.geometry: Spatially flat FLRW in the examined source implementation.
components: Canonical scalar matter; massless p=rho in the illustrative solution.
Hidden harmonic oscillator bath with source-specified coupling.
modifications: Bath energy transfer produces an effective geometric Lambda; bath is an explicit added sector.
cosmology.background: Eqs.(38)-(40) give a conditional deterministic stiff-scalar background; the printed Hamiltonian-to-diffusion normalization in Eqs.(28)-(33) is unresolved. No full cosmological closure is accepted.
cosmology.perturbations: Spatial and quantum perturbation completion not supplied.
observables: Conservation/constraint consistency and explicitly conditioned expansion histories.
Future observable distinctions require the missing source and perturbation closures.

scope: Audit a classical reduced toy model and its approximation domain.
Standard matter/radiation history, observed Lambda magnitude and quantum-gravity microphysics are lost scope.
unknowns: Reconcile the geometric-Lambda versus energy-density and factor-of-two mismatch of Eq.(29) with Eqs.(28),(31),(33), separately from the Appendix A equilibrium mismatch.
A controlled finite-cutoff/initial-bath regime in which neglecting noise is justified over the intended epoch.
Realistic retained radiation/matter content, spatial perturbations and observational law.
Source microphysical coupling/onset conditions and consumer acceptance are unknown.

Appendix A Eq.(A9)/(A10), endpoint convention and oscillator mode-sum normalization are unresolved. A nonzero constant thermal density also needs consistency with the expanding-background continuity equation.

combination_compatibility.basis: No combination with the other stochastic/dissipative branch is proposed; a common word or motivation does not establish shared dynamics.
